bar.label: Usage statistics
bar.text: MotorFix would like to measure how the site is used, to make it better: Plausible counts the pages visited and Grafana Faro follows your visit as one session. We never sell or pass on your data.

dialog.line: Plausible counts the pages visited and Grafana Faro follows the visit as one session, with a random id kept on this device; no cookies, no name, no account.
